kjv: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

lines.say: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it. Psalm one eighteen, verse twenty four.
lines.big: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

lines.say: If he made today, nothing in it is going to surprise him.
lines.big: If he made today, nothing in it is going to surprise him.

lines.say: Lord, thank you for today. Help me be glad in it, even the hard parts. In Jesus' name, amen.
